These findings collectively imply that staurosporine can influence the insulin receptor through different molecular intermediates, potentially via distinct signaling pathways. The evidence supports a possible role for staurosporine in modulating insulin receptor activity, though the exact mechanism and the strength of the interaction remain to be fully elucidated.
